purpose: Track qualitative reader maturity for every registered nested subject Room without using file size as a truth or completion metric.

states.shell: route exists but public body is mainly navigation/scope
states.seeded: unique subject content exists but another route is still required to understand the subject
states.inhabited: coherent subject reader with explanation, boundaries, examples/mechanisms and deeper routes
states.deep: mature specialist reader with unusually strong object-level/canonical integration

rules: Byte count and word count are triage/regression signals only.
Inhabited does not mean complete, correct forever, or equal in depth to every other Room.
Maturity can be downgraded if substantive reader content regresses.
